reviewed_version: arXiv:2409.01183v1 (submitted 2 September 2024; supplied PDF dated 4 September 2024)

findings.claim: Theorem 1.6 global classical solutions over the complete displayed parameter range
findings.suspect_step: Interpolation of L3 with high moments is used for p=3/(3+gamma+2s)+ without requiring p<=3.
findings.demonstration: d=3,s=1/8,gamma=-5/2 and symmetrized fractional angular kernel satisfy Lambda_b>3 and |gamma|<2sqrt(Lambda_b), but need p1>4,k1=28. Smooth positive f_epsilon=psi^2(r^2+epsilon^2)^(-2/5)+exp(-r^2) has all fixed moments and Fisher uniformly bounded while integral f_epsilon^p>=C epsilon^(3-4p/5) diverges for p>15/4.
findings.impact: Full-range continuation deduction unsupported; conditional Fisher theorem and physical 3D power-law parameter interpolation unaffected.
findings.counterevidence: Additional dynamical estimates could establish original result; constructed functions are not PDE solutions.
findings.repair_status: Restricted repair gamma+2s>-2 checked algebraically; original full range remains unresolved.

acceptance_check.claim_location: Theorem1.6 PDF/printed p.5; Theorem2.1 p.8; Section10 pp.28-29; kernel hypotheses and constants pp.2-4,25-26,28,30.
acceptance_check.hypotheses: The displayed theorem permits independent s in(0,1), gamma in(-3,0] with its kernel and Fisher hypotheses. For d=3,s=1/8,gamma=-5/2 and the symmetrized fractional Laplace-Beltrami kernel, Lambda_b >=(11/2)^(1/8)*3^(7/8)>3>gamma^2/4. Symmetrization preserves the even-function constant; the endpoint integrability has power1-2s>-1.
acceptance_check.decisive_check: The L1-moment/L3 Holder exponents (3-p)/2 and(p-1)/2 are nonnegative only for1<=p<=3. Continuation needs p1>3/(3+gamma+2s). The chosen pair gives gamma+2s=-9/4, p1>4 and k1=28. The positive smooth family psi^2(r^2+epsilon^2)^(-2/5)+exp(-r^2) has all fixed moments and Fisher uniformly bounded: its square-root-gradient radial power is -4/5>-1 and its L3 radial power is -2/5>-1. Its Lp integral on B_epsilon is at least(4*pi/3)*2^(-2*p/5)*epsilon^(3-4*p/5), divergent for everyp>15/4, including allp>4.
acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_boundary: The constructed functions are not Boltzmann solutions and establish no blow-up or false global-existence theorem. The conditional Fisher theorem is not refuted. Physical inverse-power parameter pairs satisfy gamma+2s=(q-3)/(q-1) in(-1,1) forq>2. The journal version was not obtained or compared.
acceptance_check.repair_check: With gamma+2s>-2, choose max(1,3/(3+gamma+2s))<p<3 and k2>max(2,2*k1/(3-p)); sufficient initial moment and imported local theory then restore exactly the interpolation-to-continuation implication. Equality gamma+2s=-2 remains excluded by the strict continuation threshold.
acceptance_check.severity_reason: The invalid norm inference is the final full-range global-regularity proof step for a central contribution, supporting Major under the frozen standard.

findings.claim: Continuum-wide physical kernel comparison in empirically verified parameter range
findings.demonstration: Inspected modules use finite sampling, quadrature, fixed finite differences and truncated modes without a demonstrated enclosure for all angles and parameters.
findings.impact: Retain authors' empirical qualification; no demonstrated numerical failure.
findings.counterevidence: Authors explicitly acknowledge empirical evidence and report comfortable margins.
findings.repair_status: Would require certified error and endpoint/parameter coverage; not executed.

acceptance_check.claim_location: Introduction PDF p.5 and AppendixA pp.30-32; pinned repository commit01a9d44ad94082f844b3ed4681ae33c1308019bd.
acceptance_check.decisive_check: The source explicitly calls the comparison empirical. The three statically read files contain quadgk, iterative inversion, fixed h=0.001, finite sampling and truncated spectral reconstruction, without an identified continuum-wide enclosure in those modules.
acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_boundary: No author code was executed, no notebook/table experiment was reproduced, no numerical failure was demonstrated, and the acquired default-branch commit is not proven to be the historical publication run. Approximation itself is not a mathematical defect.
acceptance_check.repair_check: A rigorous continuum claim would require error enclosures and endpoint/continuous-parameter coverage; such a certificate was not constructed.

outcome: Major proof-level interpolation gap; disclosed numerical scope retained
acceptance_summary: Retain F1 as a Major proof gap confined to arXiv2409.01183v1. Retain F2 solely as the authors-disclosed numerical-scope qualification, Needs Evidence, without an established numerical contradiction.
